channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: André Mendonça ‘criou cortina de fumaça’ para esconder o passado de Flávio Bolsonaro, avalia Aloysio Nunes
item.description: Aloysio Nunes criticizes Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça's role in escalating institutional crisis, claiming it serves as a 'smokescreen' to benefit Flávio Bolsonaro and distract from past investigations involving corruption and controversial actions. The STF turmoil, particularly concerning Alexandre de Moraes, unfolds as a pivotal moment ahead of the 2026 election.

item.title: Entenda as duas investigações sobre 'Dark Horse': uma envolve Daniel Vorcaro, e a outra, Mario Frias
item.description: The film Dark Horse, about Jair Bolsonaro, is under two separate investigations: one into funding from Daniel Vorcaro of Banco Master, and another into suspected misuse of parliamentary amendments involving Mario Frias. The probes examine potential irregular use of public and private funds for the movie's production.

item.title: Dark Horse: amigo de Flávio só assinou com produtora 6 meses após repasse
item.description: Advertiser Marcello Lopes, a friend of Flávio Bolsonaro, transferred R$ 1 million to the producer of 'Dark Horse' in December 2025, but only signed the investment contract six months later, after the Master Case scandal broke. The investment was made at the request of Mário Frias, following the halt of funding from Daniel Vorcaro.

item.title: Lula nega prejuízo e chama fim da "taxa das blusinhas" de “reparação”
item.description: President Lula signed a decree maintaining the exemption from import tax for purchases up to $50, reinforcing his stance against the so-called 't-shirt tax'. He dismissed business leaders' claims of potential losses as false and framed the measure as an act of fairness and consumer compensation. He also criticized the pressure from business groups behind the creation of a 20% import tax floor.

item.title: Empresa de Karina da Gama prestou serviços para campanha de Frias em 2022
item.description: Entrepreneur Karina da Gama, partner of Go Up Entertainment, was targeted in the STF operation investigating the movie 'Dark Horse', about Jair Bolsonaro, and provided services to Mário Frias's campaign in 2022. Minister Flávio Dino highlighted their political proximity. Frias is also under investigation for alleged misuse of parliamentary amendments.

item.title: “Mario Frias que pediu, estava desesperado”, diz ex-marqueteiro de Flávio sobre R$ 1 milhão para Dark Horse
item.description: Former campaign strategist for Flávio Bolsonaro, Marcello Lopes (Marcellão), transferred R$1 million to the producer of the film 'Dark Horse,' inspired by Jair Bolsonaro. The information emerged after Minister Flávio Dino authorized searches at the addresses of Mario Frias and Karina Gama.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro chama operação sobre ‘Dark Horse’ de ‘tentativa de interferência política’
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro labeled the Federal Police operation into the 'Dark Horse' film financing as political interference, accusing Minister Flávio Dino and the Supreme Court of acting for political reasons. He linked the investigation to the rise of his presidential candidacy in polls and reiterated his criticism of the STF, particularly Minister Alexandre de Moraes. The candidate also accused Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva of seeking electoral advantages through allies in the Supreme Court.

item.title: Governo mantém controle de remessas mesmo sem taxa, diz Durigan
item.description: President Lula signed the abolition of the 'blusinhas fee', exempting international purchases under $50 from taxation. Minister Dario Durigan stated that the government maintains shipment controls through data provided by e-commerce companies, reducing fraud and enhancing oversight. The system also enables detection of restricted items such as weapons and medications, and protects products against violations of child protection regulations.

item.title: Flávio acusa Dino de agir politicamente e nega verba pública em Dark Horse
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro accused STF minister Flávio Dino of acting politically by authorizing a Federal Police operation investigating alleged irregularities in the production of the film 'Dark Horse'. During an event in Boa Vista, he denied public funding for Jair Bolsonaro's biographical film and labeled the operation as politically motivated. The Make Up Operation investigates embezzlement of parliamentary amendments linked to the film's production company.

item.title: Mendonça apura se outros 3 ministros foram alvos de inteligência da PF
item.description: Minister André Mendonça discovered that the Federal Police produced intelligence reports against him and three other Supreme Court justices, including Toffoli, Nunes Marques, and Fux. The PF leadership is accused of collecting data to interfere in the justices' actions, triggering an institutional crisis at the Supreme Court. STF President Fachin decided to suspend rulings and schedule a hearing regarding the investigation of Moraes.

item.title: Caso 'Dark Horse': veja argumentos de Dino para puxar apuração de SP contra Mario Frias para o STF
item.description: Supreme Court minister Flávio Dino ordered the transfer of the 'Dark Horse' investigation to the Supreme Federal Court, examining suspicious payments to biographical films and Wi-Fi contracts, involving federal deputy Mario Frias and producer Karina Gama. The decision is based on privileged jurisdiction, evidence unification, and links to the PCC. Dino emphasized indications of a single scheme supported by parliamentary amendments and criminal activities.

item.title: Eleições pesam nas negociações de Caixa e BB com sindicatos
item.description: The 2026 electoral calendar limits wage negotiations at Caixa and Banco do Brasil with unions, restricting salary increases within 180 days before elections and increasing benefits costs. Caixa employees rejected changes to the health plan, approving a strike, while already strained relations at BB complicate agreements. The election prevents larger concessions and makes strikes politically more sensitive for the government.

item.title: Lula sanciona fim da ‘taxa das blusinhas’ para compras internacionais de até US$ 50
item.description: President Lula signed the bill eliminating the 'blusinhas tax', exempting international purchases up to $50 from the Import Tax. The measure, approved after a Congressional agreement, maintains state-level ICMS taxation and also benefits the export of medications for rare and unavailable diseases.

item.title: Miss Universo 2026: quem é a brasileira que desponta entre as favoritas à coroa
item.description: Marcella Kozinski, from Curitiba, was crowned Miss Universe Brasil 2026 and ranks among the favorites in Pageanthology's forecast for Miss Universe, placing eighth. With a background of state and international victories, she prepares for the November final in Puerto Rico with training in the U.S. and Thailand.

item.title: Tarcísio elogia Fachin em meio à crise no STF e defende investigação sobre Dark Horse
item.description: São Paulo governor Tarcísio de Freitas praised Supreme Court Minister Edson Fachin's handling of the internal crisis at the STF, highlighting his decision to keep the head of the Federal Police in office. Tarcísio advocated for greater legal security and demanded transparency from the Court, especially regarding the Dark Horse case. He avoided commenting directly on Minister Alexandre de Moraes' silence.

item.title: Lula sanciona lei que acaba com a ‘taxa das blusinhas’
item.description: Lula signed a law exempting imports up to $50 from taxes, eliminating the 'blusinhas fee,' and also waives import duties on medications for rare diseases. The measure, following sector pressure and criticism, requires permanent assessment of the exemption's impact on the domestic market.

item.title: PF diz que ao menos R$ 750 mil de recursos públicos abasteceram produtora de filme sobre Bolsonaro
item.description: Federal Police investigate the diversion of R$750,000 in public funds to finance the producer of the film 'Dark Horse', about Jair Bolsonaro, with suspicions of ties to lawmaker Mario Frias and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro. The Conhecer Brasil Institute, linked to the producer, is believed to have moved R$83 million in parliamentary amendments, part of which was returned to figures close to Frias.

item.title: Moraes preparou defesa pública, mas adiou fala após conselho de aliados e operação sobre 'Dark Horse'
item.description: Minister Alexandre de Moraes prepared a public defense regarding suspicions placing him at the center of a institutional crisis at the STF, but postponed the statement after advice from allied judges and an investigation operation called 'Dark Horse'. The postponement reflects internal tensions within the court and the complexity of the situation involving the minister.

item.title: Ex-marqueteiro de Flávio Bolsonaro enviou R$ 1 milhão para produtora de Dark Horse, diz PF
item.description: Former marketeer for Flávio Bolsonaro, Marcello Lopes, transferred R$1 million to Go Up, the producer of the film 'Dark Horse', according to a PF investigation. The Federal Police suspect fraud in the film's production, which portrays Jair Bolsonaro. Lopes claimed the money was a legitimate private investment.

item.title: Fachin cancela mais uma sessão no STF em meio à crise institucional
item.description: STF President Edson Fachin canceled Thursday's plenary session amid institutional crisis, confirming that Tuesday's session will proceed as scheduled to judge the investigation request against Minister Alexandre de Moraes, filed by André Mendonça.

item.title: Ex-marqueteiro de Flávio Bolsonaro deu R$ 1 milhão para produtora de ‘Dark Horse’
item.description: Marcello de Oliveira Lopes, former marketing director for Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential campaign, donated R$ 1 million to Go Up Entertainment, the producer of 'Dark Horse', a controversial film about Jair Bolsonaro's political trajectory. The information was revealed in a subscriber exclusive article at the end of 2025. The film has sparked controversy due to its content about the former president.

item.title: Lula tem 65% contra 30% de Flávio no 2º turno no MA, diz pesquisa
item.description: A survey released on September 10, 2026 shows that Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) leads voter intentions in Maranhão in the second round, with 65% against 30% for Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ). The poll, conducted between September 5 and 9, interviewed 1,600 voters and has a margin of error of 2 percentage points.

item.title: Governo Lula torce para STF sair da agenda e investigação da PF sobre financiamento do filme 'Dark Horse' dominar as atenções
item.description: The Federal Police carried out an operation to investigate the funding of the film 'Dark Horse', a biopic of Jair Bolsonaro, suspected of using public funds. The Lula government sees the investigation as an opportunity to divert attention from the Supreme Court crisis and pressure Flávio Bolsonaro to explain his ties to Daniel Vorcaro. The plea deal of Antônio Carlos Freixo was approved, enabling testimony proceedings.

item.title: Flávio tem 62% e venceria no 1º turno em Roraima, diz pesquisa
item.description: A survey in Roraima shows Flávio Bolsonaro leading with 62%, against 18% for Lula, suggesting a first-round victory if the election depended only on voters from the state. Lula faces 60% rejection and is disapproved by 70% of Roraima voters.

item.title: Allyson lidera disputa pelo governo do RN com 30%, diz pesquisa
item.description: Mossoró mayor Allyson Bezerra ( União Brasil ) leads the race for Rio Grande do Norte governor with 30% of vote intentions in the prompted poll, followed by Cadu de Lula (PT) at 25% and Álvaro Dias (PL) at 23%. The survey has a 2-point margin of error and 95% confidence level, interviewing 1,600 voters from September 5-9, 2026.

item.title: Entenda por que financiamento do filme Dark Horse entrou na mira da PF
item.description: Brazilian Federal Police launched an operation on September 10th to investigate suspected embezzlement of public funds from parliamentary amendments allegedly used to finance the film 'Dark Horse', which portrays Jair Bolsonaro. Among those targeted are federal deputy Mário Frias and producer Karina da Gama, with suspicions of money laundering and irregular contracts.

item.title: PT vê efeito da crise no STF e busca reação após Flávio passar Lula em MG
item.description: PT leaders in Minas Gerais note the STF crisis is affecting the party's image, especially after Flávio Bolsonaro surpassed Lula in the latest regional poll. The PT aims to respond with street campaigns and clarification of investigations, such as the funding of 'Dark Horse'.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro esconde presidente do PL acusado de não apoiá-lo na BA
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro does not include João Roma, president of the PL in Bahia and former minister, on the official list of Senate candidates he supports on his website, sparking criticism within the Bolsonaro camp. The omission follows Roma's absence from a September 7th event in Salvador, and the candidate's office stated it reported the oversight to the presidential campaign for correction.

item.title: CBF sorteia mandos e anuncia novidades da Copa do Brasil nesta quinta
item.description: The CBF draws the home advantage for the Copa do Brasil semifinals, featuring Atlético-MG vs Grêmio and Palmeiras vs Vasco, and confirms Arena Mané Garrincha as the host of the 2026 single-leg final. The tournament secures direct Libertadores spots with a million-dollar prize pool.

item.title: Libertadores: Flamengo nunca venceu Independiente Del Valle no Equador
item.description: Flamengo travels to Ecuador to face Independiente Del Valle in the first leg of the Copa Libertadores quarterfinals, seeking its first victory against the Ecuadorian club on home soil. Although it has never lost at home against the opponent, Flamengo has a positive history in previous encounters. The Rio de Janeiro-based club is in excellent form, leading the Brazilian Championship and remaining undefeated in the Libertadores.

item.title: Alunos da Fercal conhecem história do DF na mostra Utopias em construção
item.description: Students and teachers from Centro de Ensino Fundamental Queima Lençol in Fercal visited the 'Utopias em construção' exhibition at the National Museum of the Republic, exploring Brasília's history and evolution through photographs, documents, and artworks. The activity promoted cultural access and stimulated student interest in education beyond the traditional school setting.

item.title: Centrão recalibra apostas e passa a ver Flávio como favorito na eleição
item.description: Centão leaders now view Flávio Bolsonaro as the favorite for the 2026 election, overtaking Lula, following the STF crisis involving Moraes and Daniel Vorcaro. This recalibration reflects electoral setbacks tied to the minister and a tied poll from Quaest.

item.title: Fernando Diniz fala sobre importância da vaga na Libertadores e da crise no Brasileirão
item.description: Fernando Diniz emphasized the importance of the Libertadores match against Estudiantes and the Corinthians' crisis in the Brasileirão, with four consecutive defeats. The coach faces crucial decisions in the coming days, including the match against Flamengo at Maracanã and the return leg against the Argentines at Neo Química Arena.

item.title: ELEIÇÕES | PABLO MARÇAL AO VIVO | o que pensa Pablo Marçal ?
item.description: The video shows a live broadcast of Pablo Marçal, a 2026 presidential candidate, discussing his proposals and positions on issues such as economy, security, and reforms. He addresses national issues and interacts with the live audience.

item.title: Crise climática e ambiental é ignorada nos planos de governo de quase todos candidatos ao Planalto, aponta Observatório
item.description: The climate and environmental crisis is ignored in most presidential campaign plans, according to a report by the Climate Observatory. Only Lula presents robust proposals, while others bring vague proposals or deny the climate emergency.

item.title: Nenhum plano de governo dos principais candidatos à presidência apresenta preocupação com o El Niño, indica relatório
item.description: No major presidential campaign plans address actions to combat El Niño, according to a Climate Observatory report. Among the analyzed themes, only Lula presents robust proposals on climate and environment, including reference to the Paris Agreement. The phenomenon is already impacting Brazil and is expected to intensify in the coming months.

item.title: Crise do STF nas campanhas: Flávio Bolsonaro intensifica ataques a Moraes, e parte da campanha de Lula defende distância do ministro
item.description: The STF crisis has become central to the presidential race, with Flávio Bolsonaro escalating attacks on Alexandre de Moraes while part of Lula's campaign advocates distance from the minister. While Flávio's strategy seeks to associate Moraes with Lula, the PT campaign tries to balance institutional criticism with the limitations of the presidential role.

item.title: Eleições 2026: veja quem são os candidatos a presidente, governador, senador e deputados em todo o Brasil
item.description: G1 publishes daily updated lists with over 20,000 candidates for the 2026 elections, including president, governors, senators, and deputies across Brazil, based on TSE data and journalistic oversight. The reports are automatically generated, accompanied by AI-narrated videos, with voting on October 4th and a potential runoff on October 25th.

item.title: Eleições 2026: O que faz o presidente?
item.description: The President of the Republic is the head of the federal Executive Branch, elected for four years with the possibility of re-election. Their responsibilities include commanding the federal administration, appointing ministers and public officials, proposing laws, issuing provisional measures, and representing Brazil internationally. The role requires cooperation with Congress and is subject to checks and balances from other branches of government.

item.title: Lula sanciona nesta quinta fim da 'taxa das blusinhas'
item.description: President Lula signed a provisional measure eliminating the 'taxa das blusinhas,' removing a 20% import tax on international purchases up to $50. The measure, approved by Congress, directly lowers prices on imported goods from platforms like Shein, Shopee, and AliExpress.

item.title: 'Zelar pela integridade da Corte': Fachin envia recados em meio à crise no STF; veja o que pode acontecer
item.description: Amid the STF crisis, Chief Justice Edson Fachin reaffirms the Presidency's duty to safeguard the Court's integrity, suspending decisions by other justices and taking over the Fake News Inquiry. He also halts investigations against STF members to contain conflicts and restore institutional order.

item.title: VÍDEO: Quem é obrigado a votar?
item.description: Voting is mandatory for literate Brazilians between 18 and 70 years old. Young people aged 16 and 17, those 70 or older, and illiterate individuals have optional voting. In 2026, 158.7 million voters will be eligible to vote.

item.title: Como ser candidato? Veja idade mínima e outros requisitos para cada cargo
item.description: The content outlines the requirements to run as a candidate in the 2026 elections, including minimum ages for each office, Brazilian nationality, party affiliation, and disqualification situations. Age is verified at the assumed term date for executive positions, while for city councilors it is checked on August 15th.

item.title: Subsídio maior para gasolina e diesel entra em vigor; veja o que muda
item.description: The government increased the gasoline subsidy (from BRL 0.44 to BRL 0.63 per liter), reduced taxes on ethanol, and introduced a new diesel subsidy, with benefits lasting one month. The measures were announced shortly before the first round of the 2026 presidential elections, with a monthly fiscal cost of BRL 7 billion.

item.title: Decisão de Fachin pavimenta caminho para fim do Inquérito das Fake News
item.description: STF President Edson Fachin revoked Alexandre de Moraes' assignment to lead the fake news inquiry, paving the way for its potential closure after over seven years. The decision sets a review of remaining procedures to be sent to the Federal Police and the Attorney General's Office, without setting deadlines or automatic archiving. Fachin justified the change based on the need for legal security and proper institutional delimitation.

item.title: Flávio desembarca em Roraima em meio a guerra entre candidatos do PL que dividirão seu palanque
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro arrives in Roraima to support two PL Senate candidates, Nicoletti and Hélio Lopes, who are competing for resources and space within the party. The R$ 2.6 million funding gap sparked criticism from bolsonarist groups and a complaint to the Electoral Attorney General's Office over resource allocation criteria.

item.title: Crise no STF: entenda as decisões de Fachin sobre Moraes e Mendonça e despacho para julgamento
item.description: STF President Edson Fachin suspended investigations against ministers and removed Alexandre de Moraes from leading the fake news inquiry, scheduling a hearing on messages between Moraes and banker Daniel Vorcaro. Fachin also reinstated Andrei Rodrigues as head of the Federal Police after days of turmoil. The measures aim to reduce the institutional conflict within the Court.

item.title: Debate em SP: STF fica em 2º plano, Salles associa Prado ao PT, e Tebet e Marina fazem tabelinha
item.description: In the Bandeirantes debate in São Paulo, Ricardo Salles criticized André do Prado and supported impeaching STF ministers, while Marina Silva and Simone Tebet allied in favor of the 6x1 scale. The STF crisis was addressed briefly, with varied stances among candidates.

item.title: Aliado de Lula em MG lança “Os Intocáveis do Zema”
item.description: Federal deputy Patrus Ananias (PT-MG), candidate for governor of Minas Gerais, released a parody titled 'The Inviolables of Zema', criticizing former governor Romeu Zema over alleged corrupt practices and favoritism toward political allies. The video uses AI elements to portray Zema in real-life situations such as salary increases and privatizations. Zema has not publicly responded to the publication so far.

item.title: PT, diretor de subsidiária da Petrobras e doutoranda da USP estão entre maiores doadores de Lula
item.description: President Lula's (PT) reelection campaign has raised approximately R$35.9 million in donations, including contributions from a Petrobras subsidiary director and a USP PhD student, according to filings submitted to the Electoral Justice at the start of the partial accounting period.
